text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU nodepool 'inference-prod' reached autoscaler ceiling (max_nodes=120) — queue growth detected, requests throttled.

Ava (oncall): seeing a large spike in queued inference jobs, latency 95p > 5s, errors increasing. tagging infra for manual cap raise. @Infra-Tom can you take?

Miguel: confirmed — dashboards show steady fill of work-queue from a customer batch job around 13:40 UTC. queued jobs: ~18k, inflight limited by pods=480.

Priya: Customer impact: CS-Liz reports 2 enterprise customers noticing timeouts and retries. We should notify support and throttling policy immediately.

SRE-Jin: quick check: autoscaler logs show scale decisions blocked by max_nodes cap. sample log: 
```
autoscaler: desired=160 -> clamped to max 120; reason="maxNodeCountReached"
scale_decision_ts=2732101060
```

Ava (oncall): action plan: 1) manual nodepool cap raise (if infra approves) 2) temporary routing/traffic-shed to non-prod 3) notify customers and reduce batch concurrency.

Infra-Tom: on it. confirming permissions and quota. filing request to cloud quotas team while trying a temporary manual bump. give me 5.

Infra-Tom: Executing manual cap raise via GCP console and gcloud as fallback. running: 
```bash
gcloud container clusters update rwinf-prod --update-addons=HorizontalPodAutoscaling --node-pool=inference-prod --max-nodes=180
```

Infra-Tom: console accepted change, new max_nodes=180. patch applied at 2732101220.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: EVENT: Nodepool 'inference-prod' max_nodes updated to 180 by Infra-Tom at 2732101220. Autoscaler can now scale beyond previous ceiling.

Miguel: starting gradual scale verification — watching node provisioning. current nodes: 120 -> provisioning to 145 within next 10m.

Priya: notifying CS now. Message: "We're seeing higher latency due to autoscaler ceiling; we've raised capacity and are draining backlog — ETA 10-15m. We'll follow up with RCA"

CS-Liz: message sent to affected accounts, flagged as high priority.

SRE-Jin: Observability: queue length dropping from 18k -> 9k over 8 minutes after scale start. token cost per-min remains normal. no error spike post-scale so far.

Ava (oncall): good. keep monitoring. set a temporary rate-limiter on batch ingestion to prevent re-fill. can devex or app teams flip a flag? @Miguel

Miguel: deploying a quick feature-flag to cut batch concurrency by 50% for the problematic job ID. rolling to 5% traffic now.

Infra-Tom: nodes provisioned up to 160 by 2732101440; autoscaler target now stable.

Ava (oncall): are any failovers or fallbacks active? ops-bot, check for service-level fallbacks.

ops-bot: fallback check: model-fallbacks enabled, region-fallbacks not triggered. No additional safety fallbacks fired.

Priya: customer update posted to Slack channel #customer-updates and emailed. CS will follow up with an incident notification template.

SRE-Jin: final numbers after stabilization: queued jobs down to ~700, p95 latency back to 220ms, pod count 156, node count 161.

Ava (oncall): marking this thread as "mitigated" — manual cap raise + batch throttling resolved customer-visible impact. leaving post-incident tasks and RCA.

Miguel: note: we should avoid increasing max_nodes permanently without quota review. please create an infra task to request a larger quota and validate autoscaler policies to allow graceful overflow.

Infra-Tom: created ticket INFRA-8421 to request permanent quota increase and to document the manual bump steps. attaching the command used and approval log.

CS-Liz: logged impacted accounts + timelines in PagerDuty incident and notified account managers.

Ava (oncall): follow-ups (action items):
- [ ] Infra: confirm cloud quota increase request and cost approval (Infra-Tom)
- [ ] Eng: add guardrails to batch ingestion to prevent single-customer floods (Miguel)
- [ ] SRE: add autoscaler alert for "max_node_clamp" event and better visualization (SRE-Jin)
- [ ] Prod: schedule RCA meeting and postmortem doc (Ava)

SRE-Jin: logging resolution note and metrics snapshot. will attach graphs to the postmortem.

Ava (oncall): closing thread for now. re-open if backlog reappears or any customers report continued issues. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: THREAD_STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. first_message_ts=2732101111 last_message_ts=2732101850
